_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround on a {width}x{height} grid.
You are player {player_id}. Valid moves: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' or w/s/a/d.
Objective: outlive everyone else. Trails are deadly; wall hits kill; head-on crashes kill both.

board.after_moves: A yeke wara na yâ ti tableau ni aye so a sara gi fani oko: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Zo ti pikango ndembo {player_id} akui ndali ti so lo gue na mbeni ye ni ayeke nzoni pëpe.

outcome.all_crashed: Azo kue so ayeke sara ngia ni atï na lê ti sese legeoko.
outcome.outlived: Zo ti pikango ndembo ni angbâ na fini ahon tanga ti azo kue.
outcome.turn_limit: A si na ndo so a lingbi ti changé ni dä awe. Zo so angbâ aninga ahon atanga ni kue ayeke sö benda.
